description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
